To generate a link that opens your query directly in the advanced hunting query editor,
finalize your query and select Share link.
Microsoft security researchers regularly share advanced hunting queries in a designated
public repository on GitHub
. Contributions to this repository are reviewed before
getting published. To contribute, join GitHub for free
.
You can easily find these queries in the Community queries drop-down menu as well.
Community queries are grouped into folders like Campaigns, Collection, Defense evasion,
and the like. Further information about the query is provided as in-line comments in the
query itself.
